messages:
anya: quick follow-up from the pm: recurring partial streams tied to handshake + idle timeout mismatch. want owners + short ETAs.

liam: noted. proposed quick fixes: sync client handshake timeout to be shorter than proxy idle, add client jittered backoff, and add server grace window to accept reconnects within 2s.

marta: i'll own telemetry: add metric first_token_gap_ms and alert p95>5s. ETA 2026-04-02.

sasha: infra: i'll scan LB/proxy timeouts and propose a per-ingress flag. initial change: set proxy_read_timeout 25s for streaming ingresses. ETA 2026-04-04.

liam: SDK change: default backoff base=200ms, multiplier=2, max=8s; handshake_timeout=5s. will open PRs for js + py. ETA 2026-04-07.

anya: short canary plan: 48h on 1% dedicated traffic, synthetic first-token test every 30s. owner: sasha+marta. start: 2026-04-05.

infra-bot: ticket INC-1433 created and linked. assignees: sasha, marta.

liam: tiny experiment idea: SDK fallback to non-stream after 3 failed reconnects behind a feature flag. opt-in only.

marta: add client_disconnect_before_first_token metric too. helps attribution.

anya: weekly check-ins until closed (weds 09:00 PT). i'll track GH issues with label incident/streaming. ping me if blocked. :white_check_mark:
